title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Dipsacus type ownership separates cultivated and spontaneous provenance from flower color
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Lonitzer's complete Dipsacus entry explicitly contrasts one sativus type, planted in gardens for fullers and white-flowered, with an agrestis type that grows spontaneously in fields and is purple-flowered. Keep type ownership and provenance attached to the corresponding flower-color quality; do not turn a general plant name or color into a free gloss or infer that the wild type cannot serve textile work.

whole_source.locator: DIPSACUS entry, opening species contrast beginning 'Duplicis est differentiae': alter sativus ... in hortis seritur ... flore candido; alter agrestis ... sponte in campis provenit, flore purpureo.
whole_source.layer: CAMENA typed edition of Lonitzer, 1551, as preserved in F_COMPLETE_ENTRIES.md; not a fully corrected diplomatic transcription.

design.content_hypothesis: The text writes an owner/type change explicitly: intentional garden cultivation for fulling belongs to sativus, spontaneous field growth to agrestis; flower color is assigned separately within each branch. This is a two-branch identity-and-quality relation, not a natural property changing over time in one specimen.
design.contrast: A fixed account would need to preserve branch owner/provenance while attaching each color quality; an account that assigns the same color or use indiscriminately to both branches would differ. Do not infer an exclusivity claim about use beyond the written cultivated-for-fullers phrase.
design.smallest_next_authoring_object: If considered later, nominate one already-authorized complete target passage with independently fixed repeated type/owner and quality roles before testing; no target form or value is proposed here.
strongest_limits: The typed edition is not a diplomatic corrected transcription or witness comparison.
The text does not explicitly say the wild type cannot be used for fulling.
No target meaning, target observation, or experimental result is selected.
Duplicate search is navigation, not proof of novelty.
design.claim_ceiling: One source-grounded RAW_UNREVIEWED proposal; no Voynich meaning selection.
